sloka: शरण्यम् सर्व भूतानाम् सु संमृष्ट अजिरम् सदा ।मृगैः बहुभिः आकीर्णम् पक्षि सन्घैः समावृतम् ॥३-१-३॥
transliteration: śaraṇyam sarva bhūtānām su saṁmṛṣṭa ajiram sadā ।mṛgaiḥ bahubhiḥ ākīrṇam pakṣi sanghaiḥ samāvṛtam ॥3-1-3॥

translations.english: The courtyards (of the hermitages) were cleanswept, sprinkled with water and decorated. They provided shelter to all kinds of creatures and were filled all over with flocks of birds and antelopes.
